done_when: When Codex isn't installed, forge close runs Autoreview with --engine claude on [models.grill.claude]'s model and effort, finding the Autoreview helper under the Claude or Codex skills folder; forge doctor accepts a Claude-only setup; a test runs forge close with no codex command and sees the Claude review used

findings.body: The search stops at the first existing file, then checks its pin. If ~/.codex has an outdated helper and ~/.claude has the pinned helper, both forge doctor and forge close reject the Codex copy without trying the valid Claude copy. Select the first pinned standard helper.
findings.title: Use a valid Claude helper when an older Codex helper is present

findings.body: This engine choice also applies to client sign-off. signoff() at src/forge/review.py:346 supplies only models.review, so the Claude path calls repo.models() without models.grill.claude and is refused at src/forge/repo.py:213–217 before Autoreview runs. Even if that model were supplied, the fixed GPT-6 Sol selection check at src/forge/review.py:318–321 would reject a Claude review. A Claude-only team can close an ordinary fix but cannot accept client sign-off.
findings.title: Keep client sign-off review working without Codex

why: Reviews always run on Codex, so a team with only Claude Code installed can't close any work
